timing: Sequential fresh CLI processes and fresh output directories. Includes input staging, CLI startup/model loading, conversion and output validation. Excludes source hashing, scoring, benchmark artifact writes and prior runtime/model installation. OS file caches and model weight caches are not evicted; repeated processes do not reuse a live model. No converted document output is reused.
scoring: Frozen annotated important-information anchor recall, not a percentage of all information or semantic answer accuracy. Failed/unavailable runs have null quality. Effective initial recall keeps every selected source's anchors in the denominator; conditional recall is labeled separately.
